# `AIProcess`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

State of the AI denoise worker.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER (observation only) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, startDeNoise @0x3f16b0 (64-bit build) |

startDeNoise runs a named AIProcess function: begin, then completion, cancel or failure. Function-state family (SendFuncEvent): state is always written; stage only when non-empty; lapse_ms when the timer is started or the state is terminal; code and error at fail even when the stored code is 0 (cancel omits them); route optional. A null or nameless detail sends nothing, and non-working notifications can be suppressed while the function cache still changes, so a receiver cannot rely on seeing every transition. The events audit establishes no task members beyond the function-state family. The RPC reference reads a status formatter that writes ori_name and dst_name only in the complete state; those are included here as optional and INFERRED. Recipients: all retained 4700 sockets. No reply-before-event order is established: the RPC reply that starts the worker and the worker's events can arrive in either order. No fixed cadence. The app uses state to set an in-progress flag.

Side effects: Observation only for the receiver.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"AIProcess"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `state` | string | yes | - | Function-state name. idle is an initial/restored state and is not automatically sent; unknown internal codes fall back to idle. A formatter supporting a state does not mean every run visits it. One of: `idle`, `working`, `complete`, `fail`, `cancel`. [READ] |
| `stage` | string | if non-empty stage string held | - | Only when a non-empty stage string is held. [READ] |
| `lapse_ms` | integer | if function producer: timer started (working) or terminal state | - | Elapsed milliseconds, independent of Timestamp. Working (or any state with a start and no end time, including complete) uses current monotonic minus start; other terminal states use end minus start. [READ] |
| `code` | integer | if state is fail (function producer) | - | Function producer: present when state is fail, even if the stored code is 0. cancel omits it. [READ] |
| `error` | string | if state is fail (function producer) | - | Message for code; present with code. Lookup failure gives fail to operate. [READ] |
| `route` | array<string> | if optional; absent is a legitimate branch | - | Function-tree ancestry (for example View, Stack) built at send time. May be absent; not an address. [READ] |
| `ori_name` | string | if state complete | - | Source image name. The value literal in this build is ori_path.jpg. [INFERRED (formatter READ in the RPC reference; binding to this Event INFERRED there, unresolved in the events audit)] |
| `dst_name` | string | if state complete | - | Result image name. The value literal in this build is dst_path.jpg. [INFERRED (formatter READ in the RPC reference; binding to this Event INFERRED there, unresolved in the events audit)] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, working - Worker running (READ shape; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"AIProcess","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"working","lapse_ms":800}
```

Event, complete - Completion with formatter names (INFERRED binding; values from formatter literals):

```json
{"Event":"AIProcess","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"complete","lapse_ms":5600,"ori_name":"ori_path.jpg","dst_name":"dst_path.jpg"}
```
